name: jengo/pdf
description: High-performance dual-driver PDF generation, document templating, schema reporting, and interactive browser preview engine for CodeIgniter 4 and the Jengo Framework.

facade.description: Primary static entry point providing fluent document builders, schema report builders, direct HTML/View/URL renderers, testing fakes, and theme registration.

drivers.name: dompdf
drivers.description: Pure PHP PDF driver with zero external system binaries. Ideal for standard server environments, invoices, receipts, and reports.

drivers.name: chromium
drivers.description: Headless Chrome/Chromium driver rendering modern CSS Grid, Flexbox, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript charts (ApexCharts/Chart.js), and WebFonts with pixel-perfect fidelity.

document_builders.description: Type-safe builder for commercial invoices with client info, itemized table, VAT/tax, discount, shipping, payment terms, bank details, paid status, and QR/barcode integration.
Type-safe builder for project estimates and proposals with scope breakdown, deliverable estimates, milestone pricing, validity period, and authorization blocks.
Type-safe builder for payment receipts and vouchers with large amount callout, words representation, M-Pesa / wire transaction references, and cashier stamps.
Type-safe builder for packing and dispatch slips with tracking numbers, carrier details, package weights, ordered vs shipped quantities, and inspection sign-offs.
Type-safe builder for employee salary slips with earnings, statutory deductions (PAYE, SHIF, NSSF), net pay calculations, and bank account masks.
Type-safe builder for procurement purchase orders with vendor details, delivery schedules, ship-to addresses, payment terms, and line items.
Type-safe builder for landscape completion and merit certificates with recipient details, course/achievement descriptions, and multiple signatories.

schema_reporting.description: Transforms database queries, CI4 models, entity collections, or arrays into multi-page formatted reports with repeating headers and aggregates.

interactive_filtering.auto_filters: $report->withAutoFilters(bool $enabled = true): self (Automatically inspects schema columns and infers smart filter controls: search for text, select for badges, dateRange for dates, numberRange for currency/numbers)
interactive_filtering.manual_filters: $report->withFilters(array $filters): self (Registers explicit FilterField controls for custom report slicing)
interactive_filtering.filter_callback: $report->onFilter(callable $callback): self (Registers a callback receiving ($doc, array $filterValues): PdfDocument to dynamically regenerate or adapt the report)

interactive_filtering.description: Fluent filter definition engine allowing developers to expose interactive filter controls in the browser preview slide-over drawer with real-time debounced AJAX background updates, URL synchronization, and PDF download parity.

factory_methods.description: Search input filter field with clear button and debounced query execution.
Date range picker with start and end date controls.
Dropdown select filter with key-value options, supporting optional multiple selections.

factory_methods.method: Filter::numberRange(string $name, ?string $label = null, float $min = 0, float $max = 1000000, float $step = 1): FilterField
factory_methods.description: Numeric min-max dual range filter with step increment support.

document_integration.withFilters: $doc->withFilters(array $filters): self (Registers interactive filter definitions on any PdfDocument or SchemaReportBuilder instance)
document_integration.onFilter: $doc->onFilter(callable $callback): self (Registers dynamic callback receiving ($doc, array $filterValues): PdfDocument to adapt the document in real time)
document_integration.applyFilters: $doc->applyFilters(array $filterValues): self (Executes onFilter callback with current filter values, returning the adapted document)

schema_auto_filters.description: Automatically inspects schema report columns to generate smart filters (search for searchable/text columns, select for badge/categorical columns, dateRange for date columns, numberRange for currency/numeric columns).

ui_interaction.drawer: Slide-over filter drawer with dark/light mode parity, backdrop blur, reset controls, and live active filter indicator badges.
ui_interaction.shortcuts: Press 'F' or 'f' to toggle the filter drawer; press 'Esc' to close.
ui_interaction.live_updates: Changes trigger 300ms debounced AJAX POST/GET requests to update the canvas without full-page reloads.
ui_interaction.url_sync: Active filter parameters are synchronized to the browser URL search params for bookmarking and sharing.
ui_interaction.download_parity: Download and Print buttons forward current active filter parameters to ensure exported PDFs match the preview state.

browser_preview.description: Renders an interactive in-browser canvas with dark-mode toolbar, paper format badge, page counter, live zoom, fit-to-width, continuous vs paginated view toggles, slide-over interactive filter drawer (keyboard shortcuts: 'F' / 'f' to toggle, 'Esc' to close), debounced AJAX background re-rendering, URL synchronization, and print/download triggers.
browser_preview.pagination_engine: Automatic client-side DOM table splitting across physical millimeter sheet frames with repeating table headers, pre-table branding, summaries, footers, and watermarks.

support_utilities.name: Watermark
support_utilities.description: Renders angled, centered, multi-page repeating watermarks defaulting to 'JENGO'.

support_utilities.name: QrCode
support_utilities.description: Zero-dependency pure-PHP vector SVG and Base64 PNG QR code generator.

support_utilities.name: Currency
support_utilities.description: International monetary amount formatter with symbol/ISO code spacing and parsing.

helpers.name: pdf
helpers.description: Fluent helper to start a PDF document or render a view template.

helpers.description: Render a vector QR code compatible with Dompdf and browser preview.

helpers.name: pdf_qr_data_uri
helpers.signature: pdf_qr_data_uri(string $text, int $size = 120, string $color = '#000000', string $bgColor = '#ffffff', int $margin = 2): string
helpers.description: Render a Base64 PNG Data URI QR code suitable for .

helpers.name: pdf_barcode
helpers.signature: pdf_barcode(string $code, int $height = 40, int $width = 2, string $color = '#000000', string $bgColor = '#ffffff', bool $showText = false, string $format = 'img'): string

helpers.name: pdf_barcode_data_uri
helpers.signature: pdf_barcode_data_uri(string $code, int $height = 40, int $width = 2, string $color = '#000000', string $bgColor = '#ffffff', bool $showText = false): string
helpers.description: Render a Base64 PNG Data URI Barcode.

helpers.name: pdf_currency
helpers.description: Format monetary amounts with consistent symbol/ISO code spacing.
